The '''Tantiss Base communication center''' was a communication center<ref name="Confined AD" /> within [[Tantiss Base]] of [[Mount Tantiss]], which provided incoming [[transport]]s with clearance and instructions on how to approach and land on the facility.<ref name="Confined" />

During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|301}}</ref> [[Shuttle 135]], approaching the facility in bad weather and low visibility, contacted the air traffic control room for assistance and was instructed by the [[Imperial weapons technician]]s on duty to keep to the flight path. The shuttle was, however, struck by [[lightning]] and went down in the jungle surrounding the base. Still connected to the control room, the trooper [[TK-343]] asked for help as the stranded crew were attacked by a [[dryax]], but chief scientist [[Royce Hemlock]] terminated the connection and told the technicians that anything outside the base perimeter was to be considered [[Death|dead]].<ref name="Confined" />
